news.title: Student Awarded by U.N. Association of Greater Kansas City
news.summary_en: Yara Elkoush, a senior electrical engineering student at Rockhurst University, was recognized with the inaugural Maurice L. Brooks Award for Global Engagement at the United Nations Association of Greater Kansas City’s 55th annual Mayor’s U.N. Day Dinner.
